about_short_description.short_description: VAIS is a deep-tech company that develops innovative and proprietary AI/deep learning algorithms and solutions.

product.name: Virtual Field Probing (VFP) Technology
product.description: A satellite-enabled sensing technology using AI/deep learning to analyze satellite data for ground-level insights and predictions without in-field equipment.

product.name: Soil Moisture Monitoring (SMM) Technology
product.description: Satellite-based technology providing high-accuracy surface and rootzone soil moisture data globally, supporting irrigation and agricultural sustainability.

product.name: FarmGuru
product.description: A digital agriculture platform targeting climate-smart agriculture with modules for irrigation intelligence, crop analytics, and AI-powered pest and disease diagnostics.

product.name: Geospatial Solutions
product.description: Utilizes high-quality, multispectral satellite data for creating solutions in agriculture and climate change mitigation through remote sensing analytics.

product.name: Global Food Resilience Initiatives
product.description: Collaboration with EBRD's Star Venture Programme to advance global food and energy resilience through innovative solutions.

product.name: Climate-Smart Agriculture Applications
product.description: Technologies and products aimed at empowering farmers with real-time data for informed decision-making in irrigation and crop management.
